legalName: Business Screening Service Dispute for Correction or Deletion of Criminal History Record Information (10 M.R.S. c. 239, § 1500-CC)
routeSelectionNote: One route, stated on the letter's own face: a § 1500-CC dispute to a business screening service. No election control is rendered. The sealed-versus-pardoned status is not a route election — it is the participant's case fact, copied from the order or pardon they enclose — and the letter demands only the statutory remedies (correction, or prompt deletion where sealed or pardoned), never the § 1500-EE(3) penalty, damages, costs, fees or any FCRA claim, which the legal-design record places outside self-help.

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The correct status of the record - sealed by court order, or the subject of a pardon, as the enclosed document states
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The correct status of the record - sealed by court order, or the subject of a pardon, as the enclosed document states
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the true status lives on the sealing order or pardon, which the participant obtains and the platform never inspects
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: whether the record is sealed by a Maine court order or is the subject of a pardon, exactly as your enclosed order or pardon states

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court that signed the sealing order, or the authority that granted the pardon
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court that signed the sealing order, or the authority that granted the pardon
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which court signed the order is a fact on a document the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the court that signed the sealing order (or the pardoning authority), copied from the document

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of the sealing order or of the pardon
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of the sealing order or of the pardon
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no order fact is held for a document the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date the court signed the sealing order, or the date the pardon was granted, from the document itself

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Anything else about the entry that is wrong, as shown by the enclosed official record, if any
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Anything else about the entry that is wrong, as shown by the enclosed official record, if any
requiredBeforeFiling.why: accuracy against the official record is measured by the Bureau record the participant obtains, which the platform has not seen

requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The record exactly as the company reported it, with the charge, the case number and the disposition as printed

requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the entry exactly as printed on the report - the charge, the court, the case number and the disposition

requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of the background-check report the record appeared on
